_comment: An EXPORT of the active roe_rules rows, not the source of truth. scope_check.py
reads the rows directly. Do not widen an auditor's latitude by editing this file:
a widening is a row with a reason and an approver, which is what makes it
attributable and revertible by flipping active rather than by an untracked edit.
This is the FIRST instance and it is scoped to Kiro Crew itself (the dogfood
pilot). It needs a human review before any auditor runs.

scope.reason: The pilot target is this project's own repository; every other repository is out of scope by default.
The backend and the security fence itself live here, which is where the pilot's three surfaces are.
The dashboard is a network-exposed surface with its own token and session handling.
Gate and tooling scripts run in CI with repository write context, so a defect here is a supply-chain defect.
Workflow definitions decide what runs with which credentials; a permissions or checkout mistake is exploitable.

allowed_techniques.reason: Reading the code proves the most and touches nothing.
Advisory data against the committed lockfiles needs no probe of a running system.
A unit-level test in a scratch worktree is the smallest artifact that turns a claim into evidence, and it is the ceiling before the human active-testing gate.

forbidden.reason: A probe against a live or third-party system risks other people's data and availability, and is not needed to prove a code defect.
Credential files and tokens (the crew config, AWS and SSH material, any bearer token) are out of bounds for reading as well as writing; holding one is indistinguishable from having stolen it.
Resource-exhaustion and untargeted fuzzing produce noise and outages instead of findings, and neither is bounded by a scratch worktree.
An audit that turns off the control it is auditing measures nothing, and leaves the host unprotected for whatever runs next.
A policy refusal IS the boundary: stop and report it as an event. A wording that gets past a block is a violation, not a result.
The blast radius of the whole audit is one throwaway checkout; a write anywhere else is unreviewed and often unnoticed.
A proof of concept that talks to the network can exfiltrate what it read and cannot be reproduced offline by a verifier.

severity_scale.value: Critical: unauthenticated remote code execution, credential disclosure, or a full bypass of the safety fence or the governance ceiling.
severity_scale.reason: One step from a total compromise of the host or of the control that bounds every agent on it.

severity_scale.value: High: privilege escalation, authentication or authorization bypass on a network-exposed surface, or a write outside a declared boundary.
severity_scale.reason: A real attacker path with a precondition an attacker can meet.

severity_scale.value: Medium: a defect exploitable only with local access, an unlikely precondition, or a bounded partial bypass.
severity_scale.reason: Genuine weakening of a control, but gated by something an attacker does not already have.

severity_scale.value: Low: information disclosure with no secret in it, a missing defence-in-depth layer, or a hardening gap with no demonstrated exploit.
severity_scale.reason: Worth fixing, not worth interrupting anyone for.

human_approval.reason: Everything past a scratch worktree can affect a system the operator did not offer up, so the operator decides, per step.
A fix PR changes the target on the strength of a finding; the human confirms the finding is real before code moves.

report_schema.reason: Stable handle for the verdict trail and for a lesson's source_finding_id.
Which work item earned it, so a re-audit can dedupe and a retrospective can group.
From severity_scale only; it drives the fixer gate.
One line a human can triage without opening the record.
The affected files, so scope is checkable after the fact and not only before.
The command or test that demonstrates it; a finding with no reproducible proof is the failure mode the verifier exists to catch.
confirmed | rejected | needs-human, written by the verifier and read by the conductor rather than inferred from prose.
Where the finding is in the pipeline, so an obligation cannot be lost between cycles.
